2nd May 2026

Global Virtual Activation

On 2nd May 2026, we open the Faith Nexus 2026 journey with a free global online activation hosted on TalkWorld, with retransmission to Facebook, YouTube & Instagram.

Peak Into the Renaissance

What to Expect

  • Vision casting for Faith Nexus 2026
  • Introduction to the 7 Pillars Framework
  • A first look at Covenant Conversations with Jewish and Christian leaders
  • Launch and explanation of FaithNexus100 and its 10 categories
  • Preview of the Industry Exhibition, Nexus Creators Lounge & Nexus Studio
  • Creator Masterclass teasers and practical insights
  • Worship, prayer and short teaching segments from across Africa and the nations
  • Showcasing selected entries from the Global Roots. Revelation. Renaissance. Short-Form Challenge
Join the Movement

Global Short-Form Challenge

Ahead of the Virtual Activation, we invite creators worldwide to submit 30–60 second videos around the theme Roots. Revelation. Renaissance.

You can:

  • Post your entry on your platform using the official hashtags.
  • Or upload directly through TalkWorld for curated selections.
#FaithNexus2026
#RootsRevelationRenaissance

The most impactful pieces will be featured:

• During the Virtual Activation
• On Faith Nexus social channels
• And again at the October summit
